newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BOURSE ALLOWS LITIMPEKS BLOCK TRANSACTIONS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE ALLOWS LITIMPEKS BLOCK TRANSACTIONS.

text.p: The board of Lithuania's stock exchange decided to allow block trade transactions in the new 60 million litas share issue of Litimpeks Bank from August 18, the bourse said on Tuesday.
"The board of the stock exchange decided to list the 60 million shares with a face value of one litas each on the current list of the Vilnius bourse," the bourse said in a statement.
It also said that it would allow only block trade transactions with the shares from August 18.
"The financial situtaion of the bank should be taken into account," the bourse said.
The bank reported 4.2 million litas losses for the first half of 1997.
The total share capital of the bank is 64.09 million litas and 4.09 million litas shares are traded on the current list of the Vilnius bourse.
Litimpeks Bank was shut in late 1995 at the start of the banking crisis but was reopened in June of 1996.
It has succeeded to stay on its feet by succesfully distributing its new 60 million litas share share issue.
